text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Two Forest Hill Limited Partnership is constructing a nine-storey residential development with 94 units and two levels of underground parking, at 202-208 St. Clair Avenue West and 2-6 Forest Hill Road. The site is located on the northwest corner of St. Clair Avenue West and Forest Hill Road. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to close the west sidewalk on Forest Hill Road, between St. Clair Avenue West and a point 48 metres north, for a period of 34 months (i.e., June 18, 2021 to March 31, 2024) to accommodate a construction staging area. Pedestrian movements on the west side of Forest Hill Road abutting the site will be restricted. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the closure of the west sidewalk on Forest Hill Road, between St. Clair Avenue West and a point 48 metres north, from June 18, 2021 to March 31, 2024. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the west side of Forest Hill Road, between a point 41.1 metres north of Lonsdale Road and St. Clair Avenue West to be in effect between a point 41.1 metres north of Lonsdale Road and a point 48 metres north of St. Clair Avenue West. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the west side of Forest Hill Road, between St. Clair Avenue West and a point 48 metres north. 4. Directed the applicant to pressure wash the construction site and adjacent sidewalks and roadways weekly, or more frequently as needed to be cleared of any construction debris and made safe. 5.
